title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables

claim.summary: EpiCoach runs a weekly agent cycle in which LLM agents propose hypotheses, template-constrained model refinements and workouts while deterministic tools fit a wrist-only digital twin, move beliefs only through logged fits and sealed predictions, and enforce training-load safety constraints.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; Decision support; scientific temporal analysis

modules.name: Evidence-gated hypothesis registry with sealed prediction ledger
modules.scope_reason: Hypotheses must register a predictive distribution timestamped before the outcome, beliefs move only through logged fits, and refits are ordered after scoring; these availability-time rules apply to any claim about an evolving series rather than to one task output.

modules.name: Information-directed, safety-gated workout design
modules.scope_reason: The design space is a menu of training-load patterns scored by expected information gain against expected performance gain, with workload-ratio, heart-rate-cap and readiness constraints enforced in code, so state, actions and constraints are tied to the training-prescription output.

modules.name: Wrist-only mechanistic physiological twin
modules.scope_reason: The heart-rate response, fitness-fatigue and descent-skill components are specified for one mountain biker's segment outcomes and serve as the deterministic forecasting tool behind ledger predictions, so they are bound to that forecast contract.

modules.name: Rolling-origin replay benchmark for individualized physiology
modules.scope_reason: Targets are next-week segment times, conditional climb heart rate, drift slope and VO2 max change for one athlete, scored by CRPS and Diebold-Mariano tests, so the resource is bound to that forecasting contract.
